title.narrative: Finance in Common (FiC) Project in Egypt

description.narrative: Objective of the project is to bring a sustainable economic recovery throughout the financial system in Egypt. It will allow (i) boosting the financing offer for SDGs-related bankable investments through adequate incentives, (ii) introducing SDGs-related strategies for key financial players, and (iii) working with financial regulators to trigger institutional/regulatory evolutions in the area of sustainable finance.
